enableHepteractDistributor.settingHelpText: Adds a Distributor button to the Hepteract Forge. It opens a panel that spends your hepteracts on the hepteract types following the ratios you set. It crafts through the game's Auto craft, so it ascends several times in a row and only hepteracts are spent.

expandCostProtection.settingHelpText: When enabled, makes clicking hepteract icons in the hepteract view (quick expand and max feature) not do anything if it would cost >= settingValue percentage hepteracts

keepHeaderLayoutOnImport.settingDescription: Keep my header layout when a save is loaded (checkbox under Load from file)

headerAmbrosiaSlotsShown.settingDescription: Ambrosia loadout slots shown in the header (block next to the header's edit tray, 16 = all)

hepteractDistributorAllowPartial.settingDescription: Hepteract Distributor: allow partly filled meters

hepteractDistributorTalismanAlone.settingDescription: Hepteract Distributor: replace the ambrosia tree for Talisman Power alone

hepteractDistributorOrbsPercent.settingDescription: Hepteract Distributor: percentage of hepteracts for Overflux Orbs

hepteractDistributorKeep.settingDescription: Hepteract Distributor: hepteracts never spent, as how many powers of ten below the stock's own (1 with 3.4e16 owned keeps 1e15, -1 keeps nothing)

editGameHeader.settingHelpText: Open the game's header editor to move and resize modules, with HS alignment and half-height controls. You can also open it by holding down on the header when Long press to edit is enabled. Click Done in the header when finished.

hideGameDialogs.settingHelpText: Adds a 'Don't show again' / 'Always confirm' checkbox to the game's Confirm and Alert dialogs. Hidden dialogs are answered OK without being shown. Turning this on also hides a ready-made list of useless dialogs. The list of hidden dialogs is shown below while this is on.

hideGameDialogsNotify.settingHelpText: When a hidden Alert is answered, its text is shown as a notification instead (e.g. how many levels a multi-buy purchased). Hidden Confirms are never shown.

compactChallengeText.settingDescription: Compact progress text in the game's challenge modules
compactChallengeText.settingHelpText: Show current/required amounts or Challenge 15 scores without the challenge name, using one grid row. Hover for the full description. Inactive modules keep the game's challenge-name preview in the editor.

challengeProgressHeader.settingDescription: Challenge progress module in the header
challengeProgressHeader.settingHelpText: One header module for the challenges you are in.

challengeProgressLayout.settingHelpText: All challenges on one line, or one line each.

challengeProgressDetails.settingHelpText: After each challenge: nothing, its completions (the score for C15), or its completions and requirement.

challengeProgressShowNone.settingDescription: Challenge progress module: CØ outside challenges
challengeProgressShowNone.settingHelpText: A discreet CØ when you are in no challenge, instead of an empty module.

corruptionHeaderControls.settingDescription: Corruption module: next level and controls
corruptionHeaderControls.settingHelpText: Shows the next ascension's corruption level when it differs. Click the module to change it.

corruptionHeaderInline.settingDescription: Corruption module: level controls in the module
corruptionHeaderInline.settingHelpText: Change the next level in the module itself, at sizes M and L. The icon and the current level still open the popover.

corruptionHeaderAlwaysShown.settingHelpText: Keeps the Corruption level module in the header before Challenge 11 is completed in a singularity.

singularityHeaderElevator.settingHelpText: Click the Singularity count module to use the Elevator.

rememberSubtabs.settingHelpText: The game goes back to the first subtab of every tab at each singularity, Exalt, save load and page load. When enabled, a tab you open comes back on the subtab you last used there. A subtab that is locked again comes back the next time you open its tab once it is unlocked.

statsForNerdsGroups.settingHelpText: Replaces the grid of category buttons in Settings > Stats for Nerds with a compact list sorted into groups. Turn it off for the game's buttons.

hiddenVanillaTabs.settingHelpText: Click each tab you want to hide. Click a selected tab again to restore it.

autoDismissOfflinePopup.settingHelpText: When enabled, the offline progress popup shown when the game loads is closed automatically. Disable it to read your offline progress summary. Takes effect on the next game load.

reloadOnLateLoaderStart.settingDescription: Reload when the loader starts late
reloadOnLateLoaderStart.settingHelpText: Browser (Tampermonkey) only. Sometimes Tampermonkey starts the mod's loader after the game has already started (Tampermonkey was idle, or the computer is slow), and the mod can't load. On: the page reloads automatically (at most 3 times in a row). Off: a message asks you to refresh.

syncNotificationOpacity.settingHelpText: Controls in-game notification opacity. Achievement notifications are one example of in-game notifications.

reactiveMouseHover.settingHelpText: While left Shift is held, repeats the hover on whatever is under the pointer, without moving the mouse. Value: interval in seconds.

autoClick.settingHelpText: While left Ctrl is held, clicks repeatedly on whatever is under the pointer. Value: interval in seconds.

autoClickIgnoreElements.settingHelpText: Auto click won't click auto and mode toggles, hepteract craft and cap buttons, orb and powder trades, Retry Challenge, or dialog OK/Cancel.

useGameData.settingHelpText: The mod saves the game twice a second and reads that save, for the features that show values computed from your game data.

autoExportSave.settingDescription: Export the save every X minutes
autoExportSave.settingHelpText: When enabled, the mod presses the game's Export button once your last export is older than this many minutes. It is the game's own export: the export rewards (quarks, golden quarks) are collected and the file is downloaded by your browser, or written into the export folder if you chose one. An export you do yourself restarts the count. A file is made even if you export to the clipboard. Skipped while Auto-Sing is active. On Steam, choose an export folder first.

autoExportSaveFolder.settingHelpText: Picks the folder the timed export writes its files into, in place of a download. Needed on Steam, where a download opens a Save as dialog each time. Optional in Chrome and Edge, not available in Firefox. Your browser may refuse some system folders (Downloads, Documents, Desktop): pick or create a folder inside one of them. After each game start, the folder is given back at your first click or key press in the game.

autoExportSaveForgetFolder.settingHelpText: Forget this folder: the timed export no longer writes into it. The files already there are left as they are. In a browser, files are downloaded as usual again. On Steam, nothing is exported until a folder is chosen.

autoExportSaveKeep.settingDescription: Keep only the last X files
autoExportSaveKeep.settingHelpText: With an export folder: once a timed export is written, the oldest files it wrote are removed so that this many are left. Only files written by the timed export are ever removed, nothing else in the folder. Without an export folder (plain downloads), nothing is removed.

autoExportSaveLoadout.settingHelpText: The Ambrosia loadout to load for the timed export, so the export rewards are collected with it. Your tree is put back right after. With None, nothing is loaded. Each load restarts the progress of the ambrosia bars. When the game marks no loadout as active (after a singularity or a page load) and your tree is not the loadout with the silver border, the export loadout stays loaded.

persistentAmbrosiaLevels.settingHelpText: On the Ambrosia tab, keeps the game's current upgrade levels view on, except while the mouse is over the tree or a loadout. Same as clicking the game's levels button (📌 on, 🔎 off).

addTimeAutoLoadouts.settingHelpText: When enabled, the mod will automatically switch to configured ambrosia loadouts when ADD or TIME buttons are clicked.

autoLoadoutAdd.settingHelpText: Configures the Ambrosia loadout to use when the ADD button is clicked.

autoLoadoutTime.settingHelpText: Configures the Ambrosia loadout to use when the TIME button is clicked.

ascensionAutoLoadout.settingHelpText: Use a saved Ambrosia loadout for manual ascensions, then switch back. Switching resets Ambrosia progress. Shift+A requires a patched game.

autoLoadoutAscension.settingHelpText: Choose a saved slot. Without the patch, load or save your current slot before ascending so it can be restored.

startAutosing.settingHelpText: When enabled, the mod will automatically perform singularities.

singularityNumber.settingHelpText: Controls at what singularity you will auto-sing.

autosingKeepAwake.settingHelpText: While Auto-Sing runs with the game in view, the screen stays on and the PC doesn't sleep.

autosingStepTimings.settingHelpText: To tune a strategy: 📋 in the Auto-Sing window shows where the time goes, step by step. Applies at the next start.

autosingFullLog.settingHelpText: Logs every line during a run, debug lines included. Off: only warnings and errors, for speed. Applies at the next start.

autosingStrategy.settingHelpText: This is the strategy that the autosinger will follow

editAutosingStrategy.settingHelpText: Opens a new window where you can edit the selected autosing strategy

createAutosingStrategy.settingHelpText: Opens a new window where you can create your own autosing strategy

importAutosingStrategy.settingHelpText: Opens a Modal where you can paste a strategy that you want to import

exportAutosingStrategy.settingHelpText: exports the selected strategy to your clipboard

autosingObtLoadout.settingHelpText: This is the ambrosia loadout that gives you the most obtainium.

autosingEarlyCubeLoadout.settingHelpText: This is the ambrosia loadout that gives you the most cubes in the early game

autosingLateCubeLoadout.settingHelpText: This is the ambrosia loadout that gives you the most cubes in the late game

autosingQuarkLoadout.settingHelpText: This is the ambrosia loadout that gives you the most quarks. Note: this loadout is automatically selected right before the autosing presses the singularity button, the ascension button is also clicked so you gain the extra quarks.

autosingOffLoadout.settingHelpText: This is the ambrosia loadout that gives you the most offerings.

autosingAmbrosiaLoadout.settingHelpText: This is the ambrosia loadout that gives you the most ambrosia.

autosingNoAmbrosiaSwitch.settingHelpText: Auto-Sing never loads an ambrosia loadout, so the ambrosia bars keep their progress. The loadouts above are not used.

ambrosiaMinibars.settingHelpText: Small progress bars for ambrosia, red ambrosia and purple honey (the last two once unlocked).

ambrosiaMinibarBorders.settingHelpText: A white frame around the ambrosia minibars.

ambrosiaRateHeader.settingDescription: Ambrosia per hour in the header (S25+)
ambrosiaRateHeader.settingHelpText: The expected ambrosia, red ambrosia and purple honey per hour for the active loadout, as in the Ambrosia tab.

enableAutomationQuickBar.settingHelpText: A compact bar of the automation toggles.

matchOcteractIconSize.settingDescription: Match the octeract header icon size
matchOcteractIconSize.settingHelpText: Size the octeract icon like the other cube icons in the header's top row, following the module's Small, Medium or Large size.

matchOcteractText.settingHelpText: Add a white Oct or Oct/s unit label beside the octeract value, like the other cube modules. Clicking the module still switches between the amount and the rate.

centerQuickbars.settingHelpText: Centers the mod's row under the header instead of aligning it to the right.

removeHeaderGap.settingDescription: Remove the gap below the header
removeHeaderGap.settingHelpText: Bring the game's main tabs up to the header by collapsing unused trailing space and margins. Keeps the corruption levels visible and restores the full grid while editing.

headerHideLoadoutIcons.settingDescription: Hide the header's ambrosia bar icon
headerHideLoadoutIcons.settingHelpText: Hides the icon on the left of the Ambrosia loadouts module.

headerFitLoadoutSlots.settingDescription: Fit the ambrosia loadout slots to their cell
headerFitLoadoutSlots.settingHelpText: In a header grid cell, the Ambrosia loadouts slots fill the cell on one line (two even rows above 8), sized like the automation bar's buttons. Off: the game's own layout.

headerEditButton.settingHelpText: A small pencil next to the mod icon that opens and closes the header's edit mode.

headerLongPressEditing.settingDescription: Long press to edit the header
headerLongPressEditing.settingHelpText: Allow holding down on the header to open its editor. When disabled, use the pencil or the mod panel's header editor button instead. Normal header button clicks and dragging in edit mode still work.

headerStatsAtBottom.settingDescription: Header top row at the bottom
headerStatsAtBottom.settingHelpText: Moves the header's top row under the currencies and reset buttons.

enableGQDistributor.settingHelpText: When enabled, adds a Distributor button to the GQ page. It opens a panel to distribute Golden Quarks among upgrades that are not maxed.

perksFind.settingHelpText: Adds a search field on the Singularity tab's Perks / Penalties subtab: it lists the tooltips of the perks matching what you type and dims the others in the tree.

hideMaxedGQUpgrades.settingHelpText: The game forgets its hide maxed button at each reload. This restores your choice, and follows that button when you click it.

hideMaxedOctUpgrades.settingHelpText: The game forgets its hide maxed button at each reload. This restores your choice, and follows that button when you click it.

gqDistributorBalanceInvestments.settingDescription: Balance total GQ investments toward distributor ratios

gqDistributorKeepSkippedShare.settingDescription: Keep the GQ share of skipped distributor upgrades unspent

showDebugLogs.settingHelpText: Shows the debug lines in the Log tab. They are always recorded.

logTimestamp.settingHelpText: Shows each line's time in the Log tab. It is always recorded.

resetAutosingAdvanced.settingHelpText: Puts the numbers above back to their default values. Click twice.

heaterTypeLoadoutSelections.settingHelpText: Stores the selected heater type for each loadout slot in the heater modal.

heaterUncheckedBranches.settingHelpText: Stores the branches the player unticked in the heater modal.

heaterTickedBranches.settingHelpText: Stores the branches that start unticked and the player ticked in the heater modal.

heaterWorkers.settingDescription: Heater: workers running at once (select under the heat button)
